notes:
- **A9 Voice now reopens itself if Windows closes it for a restart that doesn't finish.** Run entries only start apps at sign-in, so a restart that was called off left A9 Voice closed, and a call after it was not recorded. When Windows ends the session, A9 Voice sets a one-time reminder that opens it in the tray two minutes later (the sign-in start removes it if the PC really restarts), and registers with Windows' own restart-apps path. Quitting from the tray still means quit. A recording that was running is saved and finished at the next start. See [A9 Voice was closed after a restart that did not finish](/docs/troubleshooting/#a9-voice-was-closed-after-a-restart-that-did-not-finish).
- **The log now says how A9 Voice ended and how it started**: quit from the tray, Windows ending the session, a crash (with the place in the code), and on the next start the way it was started.
- **Fewer repeated audio warnings.** A microphone buffer underrun is logged once with a count instead of once per callback, and it no longer makes the next dictation close and reopen the microphone.
